getCurrentUser(); if (!$currentUser) { header('Location: signin.php'); exit; } $message = ''; $messageType = ''; if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') { $action = $_POST['action']; try { require_once 'config/database.php'; $database = new Database(); $db = $database->getConnection(); if ($action === 'force_complete') { // Force mark profile as completed $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE students SET profile_completed = 1, profile_completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?"); $result = $stmt->execute([$currentUser['id']]); if ($result) { // Update session $_SESSION['user']['profile_completed'] = 1; $_SESSION['user']['profile_completed_at'] = date('Y-m-d H:i:s'); $message = 'Profile forcefully marked as completed!'; $messageType = 'success'; } else { $message = 'Failed to update profile'; $messageType = 'error'; } } elseif ($action === 'force_incomplete') { // Force mark profile as incomplete $stmt = $db->prepare("UPDATE students SET profile_completed = 0, profile_completed_at = NULL WHERE id = ?"); $result = $stmt->execute([$currentUser['id']]); if ($result) { // Update session $_SESSION['user']['profile_completed'] = 0; $_SESSION['user']['profile_completed_at'] = null; $message = 'Profile forcefully marked as incomplete!'; $messageType = 'success'; } else { $message = 'Failed to update profile'; $messageType = 'error'; } } } catch (Exception $e) { $message = 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage(); $messageType = 'error'; } } // Get current status try { require_once 'config/database.php'; $database = new Database(); $db = $database->getConnection(); $stmt = $db->prepare("SELECT course, year_level, profile_completed, profile_completed_at FROM students WHERE id = ?"); $stmt->execute([$currentUser['id']]); $userData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC); } catch (Exception $e) { $userData = []; $message = 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage(); $messageType = 'error'; } ?> Manual Profile Fix
